sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct-GGUF is a mixture-of-experts (MoE) coding model with 30.5 billion total parameters and 3.3 billion activated parameters per forward pass, maintained by unsloth. The model implements causal language modeling with 48 layers, 32 query attention heads with grouped query attention (4 key-value heads), 128 total experts with 8 activated per token, and native ...
